mapper.insert: INSERT INTO OA_LEAVE (ID, APPLICANT, DEPT_ID, DAYS, REASON, STATUS, CREATED) VALUES (#{id}, #{applicant}, #{deptId}, #{days}, #{reason}, 'SUBMITTED', SYSDATE)
mapper.update: UPDATE OA_LEAVE SET STATUS = 'APPROVED', APPROVER = #{approver}, APPROVED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE ID = #{id} AND STATUS = 'SUBMITTED'
UPDATE OA_LEAVE SET STATUS = 'REJECTED', APPROVER = #{approver} WHERE ID = #{id} AND STATUS = 'SUBMITTED'
UPDATE OA_LEAVE SET STATUS = 'EXPIRED' WHERE STATUS = 'SUBMITTED' AND CREATED < SYSDATE - 30
mapper.select: SELECT ID, DEPT_NAME, LEVEL FROM OA_DEPT START WITH PARENT_ID IS NULL CONNECT BY PRIOR ID = PARENT_ID
